purpose: Research-only registry for open Islamic NLP, retrieval, knowledge-graph and model-engineering sources that can inform Rechercher Ω. These are engineering inputs and evidence candidates, never canonical religious authority.

sources.name: Kalimat Islamic APIs

sources.integration: candidate live search/API provider and architecture reference; authentication, rate limits, terms and content rights must be verified before operational use

sources.name: Sunnah.com Official API
sources.role: official hadith API backend and local deployment reference
sources.integration: candidate official hadith connector/local mirror architecture; API access requires the provider's access process and data use/redistribution remains governed by Sunnah.com terms

design_note.minsa: Added as engineering research candidate, not as trusted religious source.
design_note.ontology: OWL/RDF can model relationships and support SPARQL, but cannot manufacture fiqh conclusions; every derived claim remains tied to source evidence.
design_note.embeddings: Embeddings are retrieval infrastructure, not truth or authority; evidence IDs, provenance, rights and verification status must persist through retrieval.
design_note.llm: LLM weights can assist synthesis only after the evidence gate and never replace source-grounded evidence or scholar review.
design_note.tarteel_api: Tarteel's official help center states there is currently no public API for developers; QUL is the supported developer resource hub. Do not encode an invented GraphQL endpoint or API-key flow as an executable connector.
design_note.api_rights: API availability, repository license, and underlying religious-content redistribution rights are tracked separately. A software license never clears upstream text, translations, audio or scraped datasets.
